name: cardiac_dynamic_graph_v2
lambda_screen: training-only gradient balance at warm seed11; grid decade below/at/above rounded median
lambda_selection: lowest validation full weak residual among candidates with full-cycle displacement RMSE no more than10percent above matched data-only; report if no eligible candidate
checkpoint_selection: validation full-cycle displacement MSE plus weighted validation full weak residual; initial warm checkpoint eligible
loss: physical displacement MSE/train field RMS squared +0.1 physical first-difference MSE/train difference RMS squared +0.01 physical second-difference MSE/train second-difference RMS squared +lambda exact weak residual
rollout: zero initial displacement/hidden state; known current/past pressures and graph geometry only; no true history supplied
scope: new passive numerical ellipsoid family, not anatomical or clinical validation
backend_reason: measured recurrent forward/back CPU~33ms versus MPS~109ms at batch8/200steps; CPU neural recurrence with differentiable device transfers to verified MPS FE residual
limited_data: one labelled geometry plus three unlabelled training geometries for verified residual collocation; independent limited-data initialization/POD; same inputs and step budgets in paired arms
supersedes: v1 seed11 validation-only pilot retained; corrected equal normalized-POD-mode weighting to physical field MSE before any calibration/test model evaluation
